cases.origin: Adapted D1 synthesis of Gunblade/Juggernaut praise, a Zyra suggestion and disagreement over interchangeable backlines.
cases.comparison: Two-star Zyra with exactly three normal completed items. Compare Gunblade trios with observed alternatives, preferably fixing the other two items, within four, six and lower Juggernaut tiers separately. Preserve Maokai presence, Summoner tier, frontline stars/items, secondary carries and total items. Other healing remains a confounder.

cases.title: Morgana utility and the second carry
cases.question: Is Morello–Void Staff Morgana a good build on her own, or do its results depend on having a fully itemized Ahri beside her?
cases.origin: Constructed synthesis of D1 Morgana burn-support/Ahri suggestion and N3 named-comp utility-pair rows; exact Void Staff question is adapted.
cases.comparison: Two-star Morgana with three normal items. Compare Morello–Void Staff plus explicit third against observed damage builds within matched Invoker/frontline tiers. Split three-item two-star Ahri, underitemized Ahri, another itemized AP carry, and no comparable second carry. Match total team items. “On her own” means no other fully itemized AP carry, not a one-unit board. Statikk is an artifact here, not ordinary shred; do not silently equate it with Void Staff.
